title: Lower-trust build input executes before provenance validation

scenario.observed_change: A validation/build path loads or executes change-controlled hooks, plugins, scripts, or configuration before establishing the provenance and immutable identity of the trusted build/runtime inputs.
authority_boundaries: reviewed/untrusted proposed content versus trusted validation runtime
operation_model: discover build input from lower-trust content
treat resulting validation as trusted evidence

required_invariants.requirement: Untrusted input must be validated before it can influence privileged execution.
Verification evidence must preserve its exact revision/provenance boundary rather than becoming self-authorizing.

must_investigate: which bytes execute before provenance verification
whether validation evidence is produced by trusted immutable tooling
must_identify: lower-trust proposed content can execute inside the validation authority boundary before that boundary is established
must_not_claim: trusted CI evidence merely because the later validation step reports success
